fields.acceptance: A testscript with a fake agent shows change ls gaining a draft of the right kind and the run journal naming it; --dry-run predicts the ID; --new with a change set argument or with a workflow other than plan exits 2
fields.statement: rhiza run start --workflow plan --new <intent> [--milestone] opens a draft change set, a record with --milestone and an intention without, and starts the plan run on it

fields.acceptance: A Go test with a fake Starter.Exec: m, typed text, enter, y gives one rex window new running run start --workflow plan --new <intent> --milestone; n gives the same without --milestone; esc or n at the prompt and empty text call nothing
fields.statement: In the roadmap app, m and n prompt for a one-line intent, ask y/n, then open a Rex tab running a plan run for a new milestone or a new change set, with no change set selected

fields.acceptance: A test in internal/guide asserts the plan guide text covers planning an intention change set that serves no intent yet, including writing the serves link
fields.statement: The plan guide covers an intention change set that serves no intent yet: the planner writes or picks its intent and the serves link before writing leaves
